newsitem.title: japan: NTT chief says unaware of talk on CGE unit stake.
newsitem.headline: NTT chief says unaware of talk on CGE unit stake.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) President Junichiro Miyazu said on Wednesday that he had not heard any talk of a possible NTT investment in a unit of France's Cie Generale des Eau.
Asked whether NTT has any plans to take a stake in CGE's railway venture, Telecom Developpement (TD), Miyazu said, "I haven't heard anything about that."
"There are many tie-up requests from many companies around the globe," he added.
A source close to CGE told Reuters in London on Tuesday that NTT was considering a 9.9 percent stake in TD.

British Telecommunications Plc, which has been wooing NTT for a tie-up that would give it a foothold in Asia's lucrative telecommunications market, is investing 1.1 billion pounds to take a 25 percent stake in another CGE subsidiary, Cegetel.
